changes.title: Poster Threads manual via Playwright / Manual Threads poster via Playwright
changes.summary: ID: Tooling scripts/threads-poster baru: login interaktif, job JSON, dry-run headed, posting dengan delay manusiawi, dan report JSON. / EN: New scripts/threads-poster tooling: interactive login, JSON jobs, headed dry-run, human-like delayed posting, and JSON reports.

changes.title: Highlight karakter over-limit per blok batch ditolak / Over-limit character highlight per rejected batch block
changes.summary: ID: Rincian blok ditolak menampilkan full text tiap blok dengan karakter di atas max_prompt_length ditandai merah. / EN: Rejected-block details show each block's full text with characters above max_prompt_length marked red.

changes.title: Preview batch: hitungan blok-vs-baris + detail tolak per-blok / Batch preview: block-vs-line counts plus per-block reject detail
changes.summary: ID: Preview BatchForm menampilkan '{count} blok dari {lines} baris' dan tiap blok ditolak menyebut nomor blok 1-based + panjang karakter + hint split. / EN: The BatchForm preview shows '{count} blocks from {lines} lines' and each rejected block names its 1-based block number plus character length plus a split hint.

changes.title: Rute /studio/batch: enqueue/list/retry/delete + unduh ZIP / /studio/batch route: enqueue/list/retry/delete plus ZIP download
changes.summary: ID: Rute admin baru /studio/batch untuk generate batch hingga 50 prompt: validasi, antrean, riwayat, retry, hapus, unduh ZIP. / EN: New admin route /studio/batch for batch generation of up to 50 prompts: validation, queueing, history, retry, delete, ZIP download.

changes.title: Link Buka halaman riset di email draf riset / Open-research-page link in research-draft email
changes.summary: ID: Email Draf riset siap direview kini menyisipkan link Buka halaman riset (/id/konten/riset/{id}) di atas link review. / EN: The research-draft-ready email now inserts an Open research page link (/id/konten/riset/{id}) above the review link.

changes.title: Statistik per-run Lab jadi collapsible default tertutup / Lab per-run stats collapsible, default collapsed
changes.summary: ID: 3 chart per-run LabStats (token/latensi/kecepatan) dibungkus details native default-collapsed; KPI dan tabel peringkat tetap tampil. / EN: The 3 LabStats per-run charts (tokens/latency/speed) are wrapped in native collapsed-by-default details; KPI and ranking tables stay visible.

changes.title: Picker reasoning effort per-target + 4 model Bynara / Per-target reasoning-effort picker plus 4 Bynara models
changes.summary: ID: Chat Lab mendapat dropdown reasoning effort per-target dan 4 model Bynara reasoning max baru (priority 300-330). / EN: Chat Lab gained a per-target reasoning-effort dropdown and 4 new Bynara reasoning-max models (priority 300-330).

changes.title: Reaper pending macet + retry dari UI + timeout LLM per-call / Stuck-pending reaper plus UI retry plus per-call LLM timeout
changes.summary: ID: Baris cover pending yang kehabisan attempts kini dipanen jadi failed dengan pesan jujur, bisa diulang dari UI, dan waterfall LLM dibatasi timeout 90 dtk per call. / EN: Pending cover rows with exhausted attempts are now reaped to failed with an honest message, retryable from UI, and the LLM waterfall is capped by a 90s per-call timeout.

changes.title: Pertahankan path prefix base URL di proxy endpoint-try / Keep base-URL path prefix in endpoint-try proxy
changes.summary: ID: Proxy /lab/try kini mempertahankan path prefix upstream (mis. /paid/v1) saat join URL. / EN: The /lab/try proxy now preserves the upstream path prefix (e.g. /paid/v1) when joining URLs.
